analog_strength: 1 + min(1, membrane), no reset, same leak and branch transfer
same_time_order: Release due training results before the next prediction; never early. Development predictions are frozen and discard receipts at the exact outcome time.
shuffle_rule: Within each training cutoff day, SHA256-rank permute labels; preserve daily support; never use development labels for training.
primary_metric: Equal-day mean Brier; paired day bootstrap, fixed one-sided lower 95% bound at sorted index 100 of 2000 replicates. Best non-spiking reference is selected once by minimum equal-day Brier, ties in listed order. This is a development screen, not confirmatory significance.
scope: Single deterministic initialization (zero counts); seeds belong only to shuffle and day bootstrap. No tuning or sealed scoring after this one-shot comparison. CPU-only scalar counts, no matrix or global gradients. Fixed LIF encoder resets at each history. Counter increments are actual writes, not update ceilings; each changed counter is charged. Snapshot repeats the current observation in 36 position namespaces to match actual writes; it does not gain history. All arms also receive bias/current energy bin/hour/weekday. Quantized ordinal and gap controls retain the entire common quantized history; analog retains shared history plus continuous membrane. Distinguish quantization loss and shared input costs from spike benefits. Raw day/time metadata is input-only; future outcome identities are evaluator-only. Checkpoint replay must exactly match frozen probabilities. Physical energy and test generalization are not measured.
